questions.q: Which social media apps do you use most?
questions.answer: Facebook, mainly, because it's by far the most widely used platform in Bangladesh. It's where my family and friends share news, and for many local businesses it's become [[indispensable]] for reaching customers.

questions.q: Do you often post things online?
questions.answer: Not very often. I'm more of a [[passive]] user, scrolling and reading rather than sharing. When I do post, it's usually photos from a trip or a family occasion, just to keep relatives in the loop.

questions.q: Do you use social media a lot?
questions.answer: More than I'd like to admit. I use it to stay in touch and follow the news, but I've noticed how easily an hour [[vanishes]]. I'm trying to use it more intentionally rather than out of pure habit.

questions.q: Do you think social media is good for young people?
questions.answer: It's a [[double-edged sword]]. It helps them learn, connect and express themselves, but it can also fuel anxiety and constant comparison with others. I think the key is teaching young people to use it wisely rather than banning it.

questions.q: Has social media changed the way people communicate?
questions.answer: Enormously. People message constantly but talk face to face less, and conversations have become much shorter and more [[fragmented]]. On the positive side, it's much easier for me to stay in touch with friends who've moved abroad.
